name: Fictional statutory authority
description: Authored progressive withholding on actually received private income, using a representative resident within each cohort and 365-day annualisation relative to opening GDP per resident. The existing income-tax policy sets a standard marginal reference rate; source-defined bands scale it. Public/local wages and welfare are outside this private-income base. Collection capacity affects actual withholding; potential tax is not treasury cash or an arrears claim. No historical tax filing law, intra-cohort distribution or other tax bases are claimed. Fiscal AI reviews use the national daily balance after protected local claims, while earlier rules retain their original consolidated trigger. Authority, available cash, fees, review and real programme delivery remain ordinary shared constraints. This is an authored bounded heuristic, not historical government behavior or optimal economic planning. Newly disbursed loans have an authored 180-day bullet maturity. Opening debt remains a perpetual calibration, not a historical issuance. Scheduled principal uses available national cash after protected local claims and reservations, before interest and national purchases. Unpaid matured principal remains outstanding without being duplicated as operating arrears. Separate ordinary borrowing can fund repayment but is not guaranteed refinancing. No historical maturity curve, default/restructuring, FX or market pricing is claimed. Temporary cash retention protects only actual national cash after capital/local reservations, up to 1% opening GDP for at most 90 days. Approval falls by three points; a 90-day reuse cooldown applies from creation. Release, expiry or government change ends protection without cancelling any obligation or granting spending authority. Debt interest accrues at fixed 4% actual/365 on outstanding principal after scheduled principal settlement. Fractions carry without compounding; only whole reporting units become due. Cash payments and unpaid whole-unit external arrears reconcile separately. A sub-unit remainder survives retirement of principal and is not cash or spending authority. Taxes, wages, purchases and prices still use whole million-credit units. Grid programme commissioning is unavailable before 2000-01-31 in this fictional scenario. Agronomic planning is already eligible. Eligibility permits an ordinary proposal; it grants no research, adopted technology, cash, capacity or shortened construction. All prerequisites, governing backing, full funding and delivery remain necessary. Full research and adoption dynamics remain outside this scenario. Fictional legal sovereignty, occupation, civil administration, disputed claims and directional recognition are independently attributed bookmark references. Future records select later bookmarks, never force a campaign transfer. Unknown records are explicit; absent recognition means unknown. No military, diplomatic, revenue, border or map-geometry effects are granted. Economic preferences use explicit fiscal target ranges and importance weights, independently of ideology labels. Operating policy distance can lower the backing target for a governing coalition or ruling-party leadership, with gradual existing political reviews. Unknown positions create no pressure and remain identified. Aurora uses parliamentary coalition seats; Boreal begins under party-council leadership; Coral's royal route has advisory positions only. Positions grant no cash, votes, consent exemption or extra powers. Other preference dimensions and party organization remain unfinished. National food and energy reserves start empty. Ordinary consent and paid administration authorize fixed quoted-price import contracts, with full purchase cash reserved. Gradual procurement uses only import capacity remaining after civilian physical needs; no goods are created by proposal or consent. Stored goods cover post-import physical shortfalls automatically, while household affordability still applies. Food stocks spoil at the market storage rate; expiry or cancellation releases only unspent purchase reservations. Energy units are generic model equivalents, not a claim about electrical storage or fuel technologies. Events have stable country-scoped references across filtering, retention and save/load. Only a government's own retained events are available through reference lookup. An expired reference is not reused. Event reference exhaustion rejects a command or rolls back the incomplete daily step; previously completed days remain. Every earlier rules pack is preserved with its original definitions and behavior. Private policy lifecycle events carry an owned programme ID and recorded stage. The link is independent of translated text, row position or policy names and survives filtering, retention and save/load. It grants no foreign access, cash, consent exemption or operating effects. Earlier definitions and campaigns retain their exact bytes and rules. The authored 100-seat election rule allocates remaining seats across opposition parties in ascending stable party-ID order. The largest opposition party leads a successor coalition; equal seat totals choose the lowest stable party ID. Display names and input row order do not settle these choices. Older rules retain their original ordering. This is a reproducible game abstraction, not a claim about national electoral laws. Aurora has three authored parties with opening seats 60/20/20; the third party has explicitly unknown fiscal positions. Older review observations are retained as calendar-year sample summaries after leaving the 120-review recent window. This changes statistical retention only; it grants no resources or authority. All earlier rules packs keep their original behavior. Authored statutory prototype: higher new service programmes require a paid, consented and implemented legal authority. This is an original scenario rule, not a historical statement of national legislation.

sources.description: Original fictional content for repeatable rules tests; no historical claims.

Original bounded temporary protection of actual national cash for a future decision. Deferring operating payments creates arrears; unpaid principal remains debt. This is not a historical cash-management or legal-priority claim.

Original fixed 400-basis-point actual/365 principal-day accrual. Fractional reporting credits carry until a whole unit becomes due. No historical debt pricing, currency precision, compounding or legal settlement convention is claimed.

Original fictional scenario prerequisites for programme commissioning. Dates and eligible countries are authored restrictions, not historical scientific discovery, adoption, research progress or future innovation predictions.
Original fictional territory claims, administration, occupation and bilateral recognition. Separate from government, regime, map outlines and campaign outcomes; not historical or legal assertions.

Original fictional economic policy positions and bounded governing-party alignment pressure. No historical party platforms, roll-call votes, ideology-label bonuses or additional legal powers are asserted.

Original costed fixed-price commodity import contracts, spare civilian import capacity, national buffers and automatic shortage releases. Quantities are authored game equivalents, not historical fuel stocks, tonnes, MWh or electricity storage technologies.

Original technical fixture for country-scoped monotonically assigned event references, bounded retained history, private lookup and transactional ID exhaustion. References are software identities, not historical facts or new resources.
Original technical fixture for typed, country-scoped links from policy lifecycle events to programme records, including same-day decisions, refusal, withdrawal, operation and observed review.

Original deterministic party-ID ordering for the simplified 100-seat election model, covering remainder seats, equal-seat successor leadership and coalition membership order. This does not represent historical electoral law.

Original bounded retention rule: retain 120 recent review observations and summarize older samples by calendar year. Means are floor-rounded review-sample means, not annual accounts or time-weighted daily statistics. Coverage remains explicit; private treasury values are never foreign public data.

Full tax filing law and other bases are not modeled.
